The part of the roadmap updated every sprint: whether the sprint goal was met, where each commitment stands, and what is blocked. The newest report stays in full and earlier ones collapse to one line each.

- **Definition:** [Glossary: Sprint report, Status labels](/system/glossary)
- **How it works:** [07 Sprint report](/system/sprint-report)
- **Owner:** product owner drafts; product manager owns status and asks
- **Links to:** Part of: [Roadmap](/templates/roadmap). Reports on: [Deliverable](/templates/deliverable)

## Template

```
Sprint [#] Report
[Start date] - [End date] • Sprint [#] of [#] this quarter

Sprint goal:       [One or two sentences.]   Goal met? [Yes / No]
Stories:           [#] committed, [#] completed
Unplanned work:    [What it was, roughly how much time]

| Work commitment | Status | Status note | How to get back on track |
|---|---|---|---|
| INITIATIVE: [name] / Solution: [name] | | | |
| [Deliverable name]: [what will be delivered, one sentence] | [Committed / On track / Off track / Done] | Free notes: what changed and what's next. Often % complete, next action, timing, confidence. | Off track only: cut scope, move dates, add help or drop it, and who decides |
| SMALL REQUESTS: [standing commitment] | [Met / Not met] | [The number] | If not met |
| TECHNICAL MAINTENANCE: [standing commitment] | [Met / Not met] | [The number] | If not met |

Sprint notes
- Blockers and asks: [What we need from leadership or other teams, from whom, by when]
- Changes to commitments: [Anything added, dropped or moved since quarter start, and why]
- Next sprint: [The main focus]

Sprint history
| Sprint | Dates | Goal | Met? | Committed / completed |
```

## DMV example

```
Sprint 3 Report
Feb 3 - Feb 14 • Sprint 3 of 6 this quarter

Sprint goal:       Field office staff can walk through the full renewal form in
                   staging, from vehicle lookup to confirmation, with payment
                   stubbed until legal approves the gateway.   Goal met? Yes
Stories:           12 committed, 11 completed
Unplanned work:    About three days of product owner and developer time answering
                   legal's questions on the payment gateway (card data storage,
                   refund terms). The real-payment story did not finish.
```

| Work commitment | Status | Status note | How to get back on track |
|---|---|---|---|
| INITIATIVE: Online vehicle renewal / Solution: Vehicle Renewal Service | | | |
| Backend Integration: complete integration with the existing DMV database for renewal transactions | On track | 90% complete. Renewal API running in staging against a copy of production data. Load testing next. Done by end of Sprint 4, 90% confidence. | |
| User Interface: renewal form with payment processing and confirmation workflow | On track | 80% complete. Form, validation and confirmation demoed in staging today. Real card payment waits on legal sign-off. Staging by Feb 28 if legal clears by Feb 21. 75% confidence. | |
| INITIATIVE: Real-time eligibility verification / Solution: Shared identity verification | | | |
| Digital Identity Verification System: secure verification in service and tested with production data | Committed | Not started. Work starts Sprint 4; security architecture review in week 2. 70% confidence for end of quarter. | |
| INITIATIVE: Counter staff on complex cases / Solution: Staff workflow redesign | | | |
| Staff Training Program: training on supporting residents through the new renewal process | Off track | 10% complete. Slipped because materials were waiting for the finished service. Without a change, training moves to early Q2. | Start in parallel with the build, with one counter champion per pilot office using the beta early. Product manager decides after hearing the advisory group. |
| REQUIRED: donor check update to comply with the new law | Done | Live Jan 31, in Sprint 2. | |
| SMALL REQUESTS: 2-week average response time for editor support, quick fixes and usability improvements | Met | Four requests closed, 9-day average. | |
| TECHNICAL MAINTENANCE: security patches within 48 hours, uptime above 99.5%, legacy support as needed | Met | Two patches applied within 48 hours, 99.8% uptime. | |

**Sprint notes**
- Blockers and asks: Legal sign-off on the payment gateway by Feb 21. The product manager asks the executive steering group sponsor to help get it scheduled. Starting training in parallel goes to the Feb 18 advisory meeting and the Feb 25 steering meeting.
- Changes to commitments: None added or dropped. Staff Training Program approach change proposed (above).
- Next sprint: Real card payment in staging, identity verification security review, first training session drafted with champions.
